info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flights API allows users to process the cancellation of booked airline flights. This endpoint is designed for travel agencies and airline representatives who need to manage customer flight changes efficiently. By invoking this API, users can safely remove existing flight reservations from the system. Typical consumers include customer service platforms and travel management software that aim to enhance user experience by enabling immediate flight modifications.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel their existing flight reservations. It ensures that the reservation is removed from the system and any related actions are taken, such as refund processing, if applicable.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to cancel a flight. It must include necessary identifiers for the flight and the customer to process the cancellation accurately.

200.description: The flight cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: Request body for the DELETE operation to cancel a flight. This schema expects a string value.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Flight Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the flight after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation result.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: The response schema for the successful cancellation of a flight operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Information regarding the auditing of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
